learnings: Survivorship/boost bias: promoted tokens can collapse quickly; WORTHLESS lost approximately 49% in observed indicative sample, while DUST gained about 13%; no executed trades.
Pool identity matters: DUST main PumpSwap pool BYFpq... had reported $34.4k, a different same-mint Pump.fun route G2Ne9.. reported zero liquidity. Don't sum both or treat route price as executable.
Coin ticker collisions are abundant: SEASON multiple distinct contracts/pools; BORLY duplicate names and DUST old same-name mints. Require exact mint and pool before combining data.
Buy/sell transaction counts without matched-window independent unique buyers and USD directional volume can mislead (BORLY sources strongly disagree).
High relative liquidity does not certify LP lock, sell depth or holder safety; aDOG reports >10% developer holdings despite active buying.
Historical source snapshots must not be mixed with fresh Helius quotes to manufacture current Liquidity/Cap or OUR SCORE.
